dataset: MVTec-AD (5.03 GB, huggingface micguida1/mvtech_anomaly_detection), 15 categories extracted to /mnt/d/mvtec
method: PaDiM-style per-position diagonal Gaussian over random-feature patches, 20 normal train images, 128x128 grayscale
reference: PaDiM paper: ~97.5% image AUROC on MVTec-AD with a ResNet-18 backbone
verdict: the random-feature embedder does not carry semantics; the gap to published results is structural, not tuning. Proven by diag_auroc.py (5 statistics) and diag_alignment.py (3 shift ranges).
